Traditional tale: 神农尝百草

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候有一个人叫神农。他需要当上医，一看别的人就想帮助他们。但是，他有一个问题，他不知道什么东西能做药。神农听说一个远远的地方有一种植物，什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好。神农三个月走去，找到有植物的地方，他看到一个很漂亮的植物，又香又好看。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. At the description of the plant, add a visual detail to make it easier to imagine: “那儿开着黄色的、像星星一样的花。”
2. After the doctor’s goal is introduced, add Shennong’s thought to show his determination: “他想：我要找到能治病的植物。”
3. During the long journey, add a simple detail about his effort: “他走啊走啊，翻过了很多高山。”

ideas.reason: It adds a concrete, simple visual detail that fits his first sight of the plant.
His wish to find healing plants is already clearly implied by wanting to help people and not knowing what can be medicine.
It gives a concrete detail of the difficult three-month journey and fits the story.
